description: This is a Java test class for the YearStatistics component in a book tracking application. It contains unit tests for methods that find the lowest and highest rated books of the year, as well as calculating the average rating and number of books for the year.

classes.name: YearStatisticsTest
classes.description: Test class for YearStatistics, verifying functionality related to yearly book ratings and statistics.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by clearing existing books, populating read books, and setting up YearStatistics instance.

methods.name: findLowestRatedBookThisYear
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly finds the lowest rated book of the year.

methods.name: notFindNonExistentLowestRatedBook
methods.description: Verifies that the method returns empty when no lowest rated book exists.

methods.name: highestRatedBookExistsAndIsFound
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly finds the highest rated book of the year.

methods.name: testNonExistentHighestRatedBook
methods.description: Verifies that the method returns empty when no highest rated book exists.

methods.name: TestNumberOfBooksThisYear
methods.description: Checks that the number of books for the year is as expected.

methods.name: averageRatingExistsAndIsCorrect
methods.description: Verifies that the calculated average rating matches expected value.

methods.name: haveNoAverageRatingStatisticsWhenThereAreNoStatistics
methods.description: Ensures that when no data exists, the average rating calculation returns empty.

methods.name: resetRatingStatistics
methods.description: Helper method to reset the test data by deleting all books and reinitializing YearStatistics.
